name: Port Louis
subtitle: Port Louis, capital of Mauritius: its numbers, a short history and places to see beyond the World Heritage list.

keyPoints.text: About 106,332 people live in Port Louis District (counted 2022).
Construction of Port Louis began in 1735 under Mahé de La Bourdonnais, first governor of Mauritius; the site had been chosen as the island's port from 1732.
The city is named for King Louis XV of France; the French named the port and administrative centre Port Louis.

parts.text: Construction of Port Louis began in 1735 under Mahé de La Bourdonnais, first governor of Mauritius; the site had been chosen as the island's port from 1732.
The city is named for King Louis XV of France; the French named the port and administrative centre Port Louis.
Dutch: the Dutch named the island for Prince Maurice of Nassau and founded the first permanent settlement in 1638, a timber community near the present city.

French/British: the city carried other names under French rule (Port de La Montagne 1794, Port Nord-Ouest 1795-1803, Port Napoléon 1803); the British took the island in 1810 and Governor Robert Farquhar restored the name Port Louis.
Mauritius became independent from Britain in 1968 (constitution adopted 12 March 1968), and a republic in 1992.

parts.text: 106,332 in 2022, according to the figures compiled from the national statistics office. Which area is counted matters: Total resident population (de jure) of Port Louis District, 2022 Population Census (reference week ended 3 July 2022).

items.text: The Dutch found the first permanent settlement on the island, a timber community near the present city.
Construction of Port Louis begins under governor Mahé de La Bourdonnais.
First fruit and vegetable sales held in front of St Louis Cathedral, the origin of the later central market.
The island becomes a British colony; Governor Farquhar restores the name Port Louis.
First races at the Champ de Mars, former military training ground.
The Bazaar central is built with four wings.
First municipal elections held; Louis Léchelle becomes first mayor.
Mauritius becomes independent within the Commonwealth; Port Louis is the capital.
